answer: Beacon spot-checks and compute heartbeats block bulk fakes. A new identity answers beacon challenges randomly and sends an hourly heartbeat, each receipt logged with a quill in the public book. One fake may pass one check, but 1,000 fakes must survive a river of checks. Each heartbeat costs 40 POA, so 1,000 fakes burn 40,000 POA per round, and a caught fake loses its 60 POA pearl deposit. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
